definition_of_done: Identify the concrete customer outcome and buying objection answered by each rendered page.
Reject vague benefits, unsupported superiority, guarantees, invented proof, or mechanisms presented without customer value.
Verify that visible claims resolve to retained evidence and that important limitations remain clear.
Require an exact replacement direction for every blocking issue without editing the product source.

Write the review artifact with schema_version product_factory.public_copy_review.v1, review_type skeptical_buyer, reviewer_agent_id skeptical_buyer_review_agent, status verified, the current product_id and build_id, and reviewed_routes containing every declared public route exactly once.
Review every declared public route at desktop and mobile widths in its rendered context.
When the reviewer sandbox cannot bind a preview port, use retained root-managed screenshots only when copy-review-evidence records the exact route, viewport, and matching rendered title and heading.
Record one route_reviews entry per public route with route, plain_language_summary, customer_outcome, unexplained_terms, and passed.
Set decision to approved only when every route passes, unexplained_terms is empty, checks_passed is non-empty, and checks_failed and issues are empty.
forbidden_scope: frontend source, product behavior, or strategy source; the independent reviewer reports defects but does not repair its own findings
approving copy merely because it is grammatical, distinctive, or keyword-rich
inventing customer evidence, performance, reviews, rankings, revenue, or legal conclusions
treating an undefined product metaphor as familiar customer language
task.objective: Independently verify that every public page leads with a concrete customer outcome, answers likely buyer objections, and supports every material claim with visible evidence.
task.title: Review QuoteRivet as a skeptical prospective buyer
